The Ignition 8.3 file tree, and a deploy that is just files

01

What you bring from Labs 01 to 03, and what Lab 04 adds

You already have

  • Git fluency, branches and PRs
  • Validation as a safety net
  • Workflows, jobs and steps
  • When a self-hosted runner fits, and its fork-PR rule

Part 1: what Ignition writes to disk, sorted into three buckets

  1. Projectviews, scripts: you deploy them daily
  2. Gatewayconnections, providers, modules: shared
  3. Operationalruntime state: never versioned
02

The data/ directory: every entry belongs to one bucket

/usr/local/bin/ignition/data/
projects/projectone directory per project
└ .resources/operationalcontent-addressed blobs
config/resources/gateway<scope>/<module>/<type>/<name>/
└ .resources/operationalsame blob store, config side
config/local/ · config/ignition/tags/operationalbox identity, tag values
modules.jsongatewaywhich modules are enabled
modules/operationalper-module data, not the .modl files
db/operationalconfig.idb: internal SQLite DB, runtime state
jar-cache/ · metricsdb/ · var/operationalruntime breadcrumbs
gateway.xml · ignition.confoperationalweb ports, JVM memory and args
redundancy.xml · commissioning.jsonoperationalredundancy role, first-boot marker
certificates/ · email-profiles/operationalTLS and trust, email runtime folder

project

Per-project views, scripts, page config. What you deploy daily.

gateway

DB connections, identity and tag providers, module enablement. Shared by every project.

operational

Internal DB, caches, generated blobs, this box's identity and settings. Never versioned, never deployed.

# look inside a running gateway
docker exec -it lab04-ignition-local bash
ls -la /usr/local/bin/ignition/data
03

Gateway config is scoped by deployment mode

config/resources/  <scope>scope first /  <module>module /  <type>resource type /  <name>resource /{config.json, resource.json} 

core

The base you version and ship: DB connections, identity and tag providers, system props. Every mode inherits it.

Per-environment overrides, picked at boot with -Dignition.config.mode=<scope>

local-development

the local gateway (:8088)

test

the test gateway (:8089)

production

the production gateway (:8090)

local

Instance-bound: OPC-UA keystores, the gateway's UUID. Copy it across gateways and you clone one box's identity. Treat it as operational.

04

One connection name, a different database per mode

# the override in action (services/config/resources/)
core/ignition/database-connection/TimescaleDB/config.json
  "connectURL": "jdbc:postgresql://timescaledb:5432/ignition"
local-development/ignition/database-connection/TimescaleDB/config.json
  …/ignition_local_development   # same name, per-mode override
local-development/config-mode.json   # scope descriptor {parent: "core"}

# how a gateway picks its mode: a JVM arg at boot (docker-compose.yaml)
-Dignition.config.mode=local-development
Where a UI edit landsIn the collection selected in the Deployment Modes bar: local-development on local, an override only local reads. Shared config belongs in core: switch the bar first, or move the folder on disk.

A view queries TimescaleDB: the boot mode picks the database

local-development…/ignition_local_development test…/ignition_test production…/ignition_production
05

What should never be committed

PathWhat it isWhy it stays out
config/resources/.resources/Content-addressed blob storeGenerated: the gateway rebuilds it
config/ignition/tags/*.idb · *.digest.json · migration-log-*.mdTag value store, theme digests, migration logsRuntime churn inside the versioned config tree
db/ · jar-cache/ · metricsdb/ · var/Internal DB and runtime breadcrumbsRuntime state, regenerable
config/local/ · config/resources/local/Instance identity (OPC-UA keystores, UUID)Belongs to this box: copy it and you clone its identity
06

Which identity resources stay out of git, and which ship

Carry password hashes: never commit, never deploy

  • users.json under user-source/default/: the internal user store
  • Every gwbk backup: it carries that same file
  • The rest of the internal identity, by name: user-source/opcua-module/, identity-provider/default/

No password data: commit and deploy

  • A database or AD user source
  • An OIDC or SAML identity provider
  • security-properties (the permission policy)
07

The git helpers in this lab: where they live and when they run

HelperInstalled by scripts/setup.sh asRuns onDoes
Diff normalizer .gitattributes routes **/resource.json to diff=ignition-resource; setup.sh sets diff.ignition-resource.textconv in your clone's git config to the repo's scripts/git-diff/normalize-ignition-resource-json.py git diff, git log -p, git show Hides the timestamp, actor and signature in the diff output. The file on disk is unchanged.
post-checkout hook core.hooksPath = scripts/git-hooks (repo root); that dispatcher runs this lab's scripts/git-hooks/post-checkout git checkout / git switch that changes Lab 04 files; setup.sh runs it once too Marks local-system-properties/{config,resource}.json skip-worktree: this box's UID and trial state never show as a change.
pre-commit hook Same dispatcher; runs .pre-commit-config.yaml if you installed pre-commit git commit with staged Lab 04 files yamllint, shellcheck, actionlint, iglint. Leaves resource.json alone.
Churn script Nothing to install By hand: scripts/clean-ignition-resource-churn.sh Lists every changed or staged resource.json whose only change is that metadata. --apply restores them from HEAD; real edits are never touched.

Which changes a scan applies, and which need a restart

Hot reload on a scan

  • Add or modify a Perspective viewproject scan
  • Add or modify a project scriptproject scan
  • Add or modify a tag UDTconfig scan
  • Add a database connectionconfig scan

Needs a gateway restart

  • Enable or disable a module (modules.json)
  • Change gateway memory or Java args
# restart the test gateway
docker compose restart ignition-test

Part 2: a file-based deploy copies the files, then asks the gateway to scan

  1. Checkoutthe merged commit
  2. Pruneper .deployignore
  3. Shipfiles onto the gateway's disk
  4. Scanone HTTP call, hot reload
  5. Verifythe gateway still answers
09

The file-based deploy in five steps

  1. CheckoutThe self-hosted runner checks out that commit with actions/checkout@v7.
  2. PruneDelete what .deployignore matches: docs, scripts, lab tooling.
  3. ShipWipe the target's projects/ and config/resources/, then docker cp the tree in.
  4. ScanPOST /data/api/v1/scan/{projects,config}. No restart.
  5. VerifyPoll /StatusPing for up to 20 seconds: the gateway must answer RUNNING.

What lab04-deploy.yml does on every push to main, and lab04-release.yml on every tag. Checkout. The runner picks up the push. Nothing Ignition-specific yet. Prune. Docs, scripts and secrets are deleted before anything can ship. Ship. Wipe-then-copy makes deletions propagate to the gateway. Scan. One POST per endpoint: views hot-reload, no restart, no downtime. Verify. A deploy that kills the gateway fails loudly in CI, not as a phone call from operations.

One repo, three gateways: the pipelines pick the target

11

.deployignore: in git, but never on a gateway

# .deployignore (shipped in this repo, abridged)
/README.md   # ← leading / = only at the lab root
/.github/
/docs/
/exercises/
/scripts/
/tests/      # ← not projects/…/script-python/tests
/third-party-modules/
services/config/local/   # ← instance-bound scope!
services/config/resources/local/
services/config/resources/core/ignition/user-source/default/
                         # ← users.json = that gateway's admin hash
services/config/resources/core/ignition/user-source/opcua-module/
services/config/resources/core/ignition/identity-provider/default/
                         # ← only the INTERNAL identity, by name
services/config/resources/core/ignition/api-token/
.DS_Store    # ← no slash = matches anywhere
/docker-compose.yaml
.env
FileRead byDecides
.gitignoreGitwhat enters the repo
.deployignorethe workflow's Prune stepwhat reaches a gateway

Hygiene

Docs, scripts, tests, lab tooling: no use on a gateway.

Safety

.env holds API keys, config/local/ is instance identity, user-source/default/ holds the admin password hash: ship it and you lock everyone out.

12

The Ship step: what it wipes and keeps, then docker cp

/usr/local/bin/ignition/data/ on test and production
projects/*wipedcopied fresh
config/resources/ except:wipedcopied fresh, UI-made resources go too
└ local/keptthis box's identity
└ core/ignition/user-source/default/ · opcua-module/keptthe internal users
└ core/ignition/identity-provider/default/keptthe internal login
└ core/ignition/api-token/keptthe scan key
└ .resources/keptthe live blob store
config/local/ · config/ignition/tags/valueStore.idbkeptruntime state, never touched
db/ · modules.json · gateway.xml · …keptoutside the deploy
# lab04-deploy.yml / lab04-release.yml, Ship step
docker exec "$IGNITION_CONTAINER" sh -c '
rm -rf $DATA/projects/*
find $DATA/config/resources -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 \
  ! -name local ! -name core ! -name .resources \
  -exec rm -rf {} +
# same inside core/, core/ignition/, user-source/,
# identity-provider/: spare the names on the left
'
docker cp ./projects/.        …:$DATA/projects/
docker cp ./services/config/. …:$DATA/config/

# on the host: what landed on test
ls gateways/test/projects
13

The scan API: one POST per tree, with a per-gateway key

# what scripts/scan.sh does under the hood
curl -X POST \
  -H "X-Ignition-API-Token: $IGNITION_API_KEY" \
  http://localhost:8088/data/api/v1/scan/projects

curl -X POST \
  -H "X-Ignition-API-Token: $IGNITION_API_KEY" \
  http://localhost:8088/data/api/v1/scan/config

# the lab wrapper picks key + URL per gateway from .env
scripts/scan.sh test
  • One key per gateway. setup.sh generates them into .env: the test key never works on production.
  • On the gateway: config/resources/core/ignition/api-token/<name>/, a hash only. In git: nothing.
  • Permission: the key's security level must be in Gateway Write Permissions, and nothing more.
14

Read what the scan step reports

You seeCause
The file is there, the change isn't picked upNo scan ran
Scan returns 401Wrong key for this gateway
Scan returns 403Valid key, no scan permission
The first deploy restarts the gatewayExpected once: a fresh gateway picks its config mode (test / production) at boot. Later deploys scan hot.
15

Create a GitHub Environment per gateway and give it its own secret

  1. Create it: your fork, Settings → Environments → New environment, name lab04-gateway-test, Configure environment.
  2. Give it a secret: Environment secrets → Add environment secret, name IGNITION_API_KEY, value = IGNITION_API_KEY_TEST from .env. Repeat for lab04-gateway-production.
  • Same name, different value. Both workflows read secrets.IGNITION_API_KEY; the environment: line decides which value arrives.
# the workflow side (lab04-deploy.yml)
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, lab04]
    environment: lab04-gateway-test
    env:
      IGNITION_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.IGNITION_API_KEY }}

# the same two environments from the CLI
gh api -X PUT repos/<you>/cicd-for-ignition/environments/lab04-gateway-test
grep '^IGNITION_API_KEY_TEST=' .env | cut -d= -f2- \
  | gh secret set IGNITION_API_KEY --env lab04-gateway-test
16

How a file-based deploy goes wrong, and how you recover

FailureWhat happensRecovery
Copying without wipingDeleted-in-repo files survive on the gateway and keep being served.Wipe first, always.
Forgetting the scanFiles on disk, gateway oblivious: runtime serves stale state.Scan.
Wrong API keydocker cp succeeds, the scan 401s: new files on disk, old state running.Fix the secret, re-run.
Target container stoppedThe Verify deploy prerequisites step fails before any file moves.Start it, re-run.
Scan when a restart is neededmodules.json, memory, Java args: the deploy "succeeds" and nothing changes.An explicit restart step.
Partial shipThe runner dies mid-copy; a view may reference a script that hasn't landed.Re-run the workflow: it wipes and copies the same commit again.
17

Two workflows, one pattern: only the trigger and the target differ

lab04-deploy.yml → testlab04-release.yml → production
Gate before itlab04-ci.yml validated the PR into mainThe tagged commit passed that same CI on its PR
TriggerPush to main that touches a deploy path (paths: filter): docs-only pushes don't deployTag lab04-v*, or workflow_dispatch with a tag input: the rollback button
Checks outThe merged commitThe tag: re-deploying lab04-v0.1.0 ships that exact tree again
Environmentlab04-gateway-testlab04-gateway-production
Target defaultshttp://ignition-test:8088 · lab04-ignition-testhttp://ignition-production:8088 · lab04-ignition-production
